svg.text: The model holds a persistent cross-sectional tilt
w-bar = time average of the daily cross-sectionally standardized prediction, per Taiwanese stock.
Long semiconductors, short telecom. Same sign in both folds.
average z-score of the daily prediction
0 = that day's cross-sectional mean of the 50 stocks, averaged over 246 trading days
Semiconductors vs rest dw-bar +0.1804 (fold 1) / +0.1810 (fold 2), 10/10 seeds each
Reproducibility of w-bar: corr +0.745 across seeds, +0.789 across folds (random-direction control SD 0.146).
How to read +0.30 (TSMC): its prediction sits 0.30 SD above the daily average. In ranks that is top-5 on 42% of days
and bottom-10 on 35% - the tilt is a net over two extremes, not a steady placement.
Cross-seed SD is 0.072 at the median against a cross-sectional SD of 0.133 in w-bar, so read groups, not individual pairs.
